skill.name: executing-marketing-campaigns
skill.description: Plan, create, execute, and measure marketing campaigns across email, social, content, paid media, and launch workflows.

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown examples, relative documentation links, and marketing terminology. One medium filesystem risk remains because the utility script can write to a user-supplied output path. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential exfiltration, malicious network activity, or social engineering intent.

remediation.issue: Unrestricted CSV output path in scripts/marketing_utils.py.
remediation.suggestion: Restrict output files to the current project, reject absolute paths and parent traversal, and require an overwrite flag for existing files.

content.value_statement: Marketing teams need consistent plans, channel assets, and measurement before launch. This skill provides campaign workflows, templates, UTM tools, and reporting guidance.
actual_capabilities: Creates campaign plans with objectives, audiences, channels, timelines, and KPIs.
Drafts email sequences, social posts, landing page copy, ads, and campaign briefs.
Applies brand voice, tone, positioning, and visual guidance to campaign assets.
Generates and validates UTM parameters through the included Python utility.
Builds campaign reporting plans with funnel metrics, attribution notes, and post-campaign analysis.
limitations: Does not send emails, publish posts, buy ads, or connect to marketing platforms.
Requires user-provided brand, audience, product, budget, and performance data.
Uses general marketing frameworks that need validation against current market conditions.
The utility script writes local CSV exports and should be run with trusted file paths.

use_cases.title: Launch a Product Campaign
use_cases.description: Create launch messaging, channel plans, email copy, social posts, tracking links, and success metrics.

use_cases.title: Build a Lead Generation Program
use_cases.description: Plan an offer, landing page, paid and organic channels, nurture emails, and conversion reporting.

use_cases.title: Review Campaign Performance
use_cases.description: Define KPIs, organize channel results, compare performance to targets, and recommend next actions.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Campaign Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a marketing campaign plan for [product] targeting [audience]. Include objective, channels, key message, timeline, and success metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Draft Channel Assets
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft campaign assets for [campaign]. Include three emails, five social posts, landing page sections, and paid ad copy.

prompt_templates.title: Set Up Measurement
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a measurement plan for [campaign]. Include funnel metrics, UTM naming, dashboard sections, and reporting cadence.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize a Live Campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these campaign results: [results]. Identify performance gaps, likely causes, test ideas, budget changes, and next-week priorities.

output_examples.input: Plan a product launch campaign for a B2B analytics feature.
output: Objective: generate qualified demos from operations and analytics leaders.
Channels: launch email, LinkedIn posts, sponsored content, customer webinar, and sales enablement notes.
Measurement: demo requests, landing page conversion rate, email click rate, webinar registrations, and pipeline influence.

output_examples.input: Create a reporting framework for an email nurture campaign.
output: Track open rate, click rate, reply rate, unsubscribe rate, demo requests, and assisted revenue.
Compare results by segment, send time, subject line, and CTA type.
Review weekly during launch and summarize learnings after the final email.

best_practices: Provide brand voice, audience segments, offer details, budget, and conversion goals before requesting assets.
Use the same UTM naming rules across every campaign channel and asset.
Review generated copy for legal claims, accessibility, brand fit, and platform policy compliance.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a full campaign without a target audience or measurable objective.
Do not publish generated content without checking facts, claims, links, and compliance requirements.
Do not compare channel performance without consistent tracking and attribution rules.

faq.question: Can this skill publish campaigns automatically?
faq.answer: No. It creates plans, copy, tracking guidance, and reports. Users must publish through their own marketing tools.

faq.question: Does it support email and social media work?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for email sequences, newsletters, social calendars, paid ads, and platform-specific messaging.

faq.question: Can it generate tracking links?
faq.answer: Yes. The included Python utility can generate UTM parameters, build tracking URLs, validate links, and export CSV files.

faq.question: What information should I provide first?
faq.answer: Provide the product, audience, goal, offer, launch date, channels, brand rules, and current performance benchmarks.

faq.question: Is this useful for Codex and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. Claude, Codex, and Claude Code can use the reference files and utility script for campaign planning tasks.

faq.question: What should be reviewed before launch?
faq.answer: Review factual claims, legal approvals, accessibility, spam compliance, platform policies, links, tracking, and brand consistency.
